title: Get paid on time
tagline: Late payers handled for you, and a buffer while you wait.

steps.title: Who owes you what
steps.description: KBC spots the missing payments from a client who used to pay every month.
steps.why: Based on your own incoming payments.
steps.result: {late_client} has not paid since {late_since}: about €{open_total} is open.

steps.title: Friendly reminders
steps.description: Reminders go out automatically over Peppol and e-mail.
steps.why: Linked to your invoicing; it only sees your company details.
steps.result: Reminders sent for the open invoices. The client has opened them.

steps.title: Collection by a specialist
steps.description: If reminders don't work, Go Solid collects amicably and keeps the client relationship intact.
steps.why: Registered amicable debt collector; it only sees the invoices you select.

win.customer: Your money back, the client kept

steps.result: Go Solid recovered €{open_total}. The client agreed to pay within 14 days from now on.

steps.title: A buffer while you wait
steps.description: A cash credit facility on standby: you only pay interest if you use it.
steps.result: €5,000 buffer on standby, only charged when used.
